request_new_team_body: {name} sent a request through the site ({kind}). Please reply soon.
appointment_requested_client_body: We received your request for {service} on {date} at {time}. We will tell you as soon as it is confirmed.
appointment_confirmed_client_body: We look forward to seeing you for {service} on {date} at {time}.
appointment_cancelled_client_body: The appointment for {service} on {date} at {time} was cancelled.
reminder_day_before_client_body: A reminder: {service} on {date} at {time}. Let us know if you are coming.
reminder_declined_reception_body: {client} cancelled the appointment on {date} at {time}. The slot is free.
package_running_low_reception_body: {client} has {remaining} sessions left in the package.
leave_approved_requester_body: Your leave from {from} to {to} was approved.
leave_declined_requester_body: Your request for {from} – {to} was not approved.
payment_recorded_client_body: We recorded your payment of {amount} for {service}. Thank you!
team_invite_invitee_subject: You have been added to the team
team_invite_invitee_body: Hello, {name}! The team has added you to the scheduling console. If this is your first time, press “Forgot password” on the sign-in page and set your password with this e-mail address.
reminder_two_hours_client_subject: You have an appointment in two hours
reminder_two_hours_client_body: {service}, today, at {time}. We look forward to seeing you.
package_running_low_client_subject: Your package is nearly used up
package_running_low_client_body: You have {remaining} sessions left in your package. Write or call us and we will renew it.
feedback_requested_client_body: It helps us to know how {service} on {date} went. It takes a minute, and the link works once.
account_invite_client_body: The team has prepared an online account{behalf}. In it you see your appointments and can switch on notifications on your phone. Set a password and you are in. The link works until {expires}; if you did not ask for the account, ignore this message.
account_invite_existing_client_body: You already have an online account with this address. We linked it to your details{behalf}, so you can sign in straight away. The link works until {expires}.
account_activated_client_body: Thank you, your online account is ready. You see your appointments and can switch on notifications on your phone.
reminder_failed_reception_body: The reminder for {client}, {date}, at {time}, could not be sent ({reason}).
blacklist_attempt_reception_body: A booking attempt ({channel}) met a blacklist entry ({severity}). Nothing was created.
record_todo_practitioner_body: {service} with {client}, {date}, at {time}: the report is waiting to be filled in.
feedback_negative_owners_body: A client gave {rating} out of 5. Read it and reply.
delivery_failed_owners_body: A message ({what}) could not be sent after {count} attempts.
word_conflict_practitioner: the therapist has another appointment at the same time
word_conflict_room: the room is taken at the same time
word_conflict_device: the device is taken at the same time
word_conflict_roster: the therapist is not working then (a day off, leave, or outside their hours)
email_reply_hint: You can reply to this message.
link_result_confirmed_body: We look forward to seeing you. The team has been told.
link_result_declined_body: We cancelled the appointment and the slot is free. For another time, open the booking page.
link_result_expired_body: This link is no longer valid. Call or write to us and we will sort it out.
link_result_invalid_body: This link is not correct. Open it again from the e-mail or contact us.
link_result_already_body: Your answer is recorded; there is nothing more to do.
link_result_gone_title: The appointment is no longer active
link_result_gone_body: The appointment was already cancelled or has passed. Contact us if you need help.
link_ask_body: Press the button to send your answer. Nothing happens until you press.
invite_ask_body: Press the button to continue. Nothing happens until you press it.
invite_expired_body: The link is no longer valid. Tell the clinic and they will send a new invitation.
invite_replaced_body: We sent you another link since. Use the most recent e-mail.
invite_revoked_title: The invitation is no longer valid
invite_revoked_body: The invitation was withdrawn. Contact the clinic if you need help.
invite_active_body: There is nothing left to do here. Sign in from the account page.
invite_unavailable_body: Sign-in is not answering. Try again in a few minutes.
inbox_error: We could not load the notifications.
